attributes.name: Druva - Sensitive Resource Access
attributes.description: Detects sensitive resource access in Druva Data Security Cloud events.
author: Druva
tags: Druva Detection Pack 5 – Data Access & Insider Risk

meta.pack: Druva Detection Pack 5 – Data Access & Insider Risk
meta.customer_usecase: Detects sensitive resource access in Druva Data Security Cloud events.

attributes.query:
FROM logs-druva.event-*
| WHERE TO_LOWER(COALESCE(druva.resource.name, "")) LIKE "*sensitive*" OR TO_LOWER(COALESCE(druva.resource.name, "")) LIKE "*confidential*"
| KEEP @timestamp, event.id, event.action, event.outcome, event.severity, druva.feature, druva.event_type, user.name, user.email, source.ip, druva.resource.name, message
| SORT @timestamp DESC
| LIMIT 100
